reference_mechanic: A shared budget and changing hand of policy cards are dragged onto regions; choices change regional emissions and employment before the player certifies the combined objective.
transformation: The implementation is a new fictional archipelago with seeded region geometry, policy catalog, research tracks, budget, and turn limits. It preserves the surveyed card-to-region planning loop while using original names, artwork, styling, generated effects, and grading.
license_note: The source is cited as inspiration and study material; no source artwork, code, map, text, or other presentation asset is bundled.
